INSERT INTO ctaex.registros (timestamp, device_id, zone, ph, ec, temp_agua, temp_aire, humedad, co2, luz_par, o2_disuelto, raw_payload)
VALUES (
  '{{$json.timestamp}}',
  '{{$json.device_id}}',
  '{{$json.zone}}',
  {{$json.ph}},
  {{$json.ec}},
  {{$json.temp_agua}},
  {{$json.temp_aire}},
  {{$json.humedad}},
  {{$json.co2}},
  {{$json.luz_par}},
  {{$json.o2_disuelto}},
  '{{$json.raw_payload}}'
) RETURNING id;
SELECT * FROM ctaex.registros WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50;
SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ctaex.alertas WHERE device_id = '{{$json.device_id}}' AND parametro = '{{$json.parametro}}' AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND nivel = '{{$json.nivel}}';

INSERT INTO ctaex.alertas (device_id, zone, parametro, valor, nivel, prioridad, timestamp, notificado)
VALUES ('{{$json.device_id}}', '{{$json.zone}}', '{{$json.parametro}}', {{$json.valor}}, '{{$json.nivel}}', {{$json.prioridad}}, '{{$json.timestamp}}', true);

SELECT device_id, zone, AVG(ph) as avg_ph, AVG(ec) as avg_ec, AVG(temp_agua) as avg_temp_agua, AVG(temp_aire) as avg_temp_aire, AVG(humedad) as avg_humedad, AVG(co2) as avg_co2, COUNT(*) as num_registros, MAX(timestamp) as ultima_lectura FROM ctaex.registros WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY device_id, zone;

INSERT INTO ctaex.metricas (timestamp, total_dispositivos, zonas_activas, kpi_json, evaluaciones_json)
VALUES ('{{$json.timestamp}}', {{$json.total_dispositivos}}, {{$json.zonas_activas}}, '{{JSON.stringify($json.kpi_resumen)}}', '{{JSON.stringify($json.evaluaciones)}}');
SELECT * FROM ctaex.metricas ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 24;
SELECT device_id, zone, ph, ec, temp_agua, temp_aire, humedad, co2, timestamp FROM ctaex.registros WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' ORDER BY timestamp DESC;
SELECT * FROM ctaex.alertas WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100;
